states.name: rollover interrupted
states.note: a rollover wrote its head and crashed before its part; the next append recovers

states.name: removal started
states.note: a removal's first transaction committed; readers scrub, and any client finishes it

states.name: removal partway
states.note: one part is under the new key, the other still under the old

states.name: turning off
states.note: a batched turn-off committed its first transaction; resuming removes history and keeps it off

states.name: off
states.note: history is off: the entry, no records
